name: novel-writing
description: Universal novel writing toolkit covering sci-fi, fantasy, xianxia, and urban fantasy genres. Three coordinated skills: novel-write (six-phase methodology: worldbuilding, characters, outline, prose), novel-deslop (AI-taste detection and removal with deterministic scripts), and novel-review (multi-angle structural/prose/consistency review). Includes three shared subagents for structure design, prose execution, and consistency checking.
